sentences.display: Ibn Kathīr rejected all of it.
sentences.tts: Ibn Katheer rejected all of it.

sentences.display: فإن هذا كله من خرافات الإسرائيليين. فهذه الحكاية ليس يصح إسنادها.
sentences.tts: فَإِنَّ هَذَا كُلَّهُ مِنْ خُرَافَاتِ الْإِسْرَائِيلِيِّينْ. فَهَذِهِ الْحِكَايَةُ لَيْسَ يَصِحُّ إِسْنَادُهَا.

sentences.display: These were, in his words, fables of the Israʾīliyyāt.
sentences.tts: These were, in his words, fables of the Israa-eeliyyaat.

sentences.display: The tale of Ibn Qilāba, he said, had no sound chain of transmission, and was certainly not authentic.
sentences.tts: The tale of Ibn Qilaaba, he said, had no sound chain of transmission, and was certainly not authentic.
